missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Здание' is a neuter noun staying in the nominative as the predicate. 'Высокое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Здание' is neuter, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'видим'. 'Красивое старое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Здания' is genitive after 'около', marking location near the building.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Зданию' is dative after 'к', expressing the goal of motion. 'Вокзала' is genitive showing whose building it is.

missions.phrase: Мой офис находится в этом здании.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Здании' is prepositional after 'в', marking location. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Зданием' is instrumental after 'за', expressing position behind the building.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Здания' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Новые' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Здания' is genitive after 'из', expressing motion out of the building. 'Старого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Зданий' is genitive plural after 'мимо', expressing passing by. 'Высоких' agrees in the plural genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a question. 'Здание' is nominative as the subject. 'Какое' agrees in the neuter nominative, asking which building lies ahead.
